summary: The hybrid dominated-measure argument is correct. Midpoint orientation into a closed halfspace is valid, the per-edge ownership and quarter-degree bounds give the required pointwise density budget without duplicating reused contacts, doubling the aggregate density has the stated metronoid mass and normalization, and the simultaneous midpoint-central specialization respects the single edge load. The exact midpoint and central ancestry aliases survive all atom collisions, the residual theorem applies with the stated intrinsic support ranks, and the zero-mass cases are handled without assigning ranks to empty supports.
